messages:
maria: Quick pulse — holiday retargeting test update. CPC +12% MoM, CTR stable, but conv rate down 8%. Not catastrophic but budget pacing overshooting predicted spend by ~15% if we keep bids.
jon: Ugh. Which audience bucket is spiking cost?
ads-bot: (auto) Audience: all_site_visitors_30d size=420k, top spend by: dynamic_creative_2 / search-branded.
samira: Looks like all_site_visitors_30d + high frequency creative is the main driver. Frequency up to 6 for the group. We should throttle. :eyes:
kevin: Can we try microsegmenting the 30d into 0-7 vs 8-30 and run different bids? 0-7 usually converts better.
anita: +1 to segmentation. Also swap in the new headline set (H2) for the 8-30 bucket — last A/B showed H2 lifts CTR by ~9% on similar audiences.
maria: Plan: split audience, reduce max CPC on 8-30 by 20%, shift 40% of 8-30 spend to prospecting (lookalike seed) via retargeting budget cap, and swap creative. Who can push the changes?
mike: I can do the split and bid rules now. Proposed bid rules: ```
ad_group: retarget_8_30
max_cpc: current * 0.8
pacing: even_daily
creative: H2-set
note: cap frequency at 3
```
jon: Also can we add a pause condition if CPA > target for 24h? e.g., auto-pause:
```
if (24h_cpa > target_cpa * 1.25) pause_ad_group()
```
samira: Love that. Add an alert to #marketing when the rule triggers.
anita: For search, branded terms are fine; non-branded is where costs ballooned. Suggest trimming non-branded exact-match to tie to high-intent keywords and reduce broad match spend.
maria: Agreed. mike, after you push, reduce non-branded broad match budget by 30% and set exact-match bids +5% on top-performing queries.
mike: Pushing changes in 10. Will post a screenshot of the new budget sheet after.
ads-bot: (auto) Campaign changes scheduled: retarget split + bid update by mike at 1749200120.
maria: Also — creative refresh cadence: let's not rotate more than 2 variants per audience per week. High churn seems to increase CPC in tests.
kevin: Noted. For the webinar landing, switch utm to utm_campaign=holiday_retarget_v2 and include a short testimonial in hero for 0-7 bucket.
anita: I'll update the landing copy. Link: https://redwood.com/webinar/holiday-tech (draft).
jon: After 48h we'll reassess pacing and conv rate. If CPA improves <10% from baseline, we scale back to previous budget. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks team. Mike, drop the screenshot and confirm rule IDs. We'll reconvene if alerts fire.
mike: Screenshot posted in thread. Rule IDs: BR-872, PAUSE-174.
samira: Nice. Good to be conservative heading into peak.
ads-bot: (auto) Alert will post to #marketing if BR-872 triggers.
